topic.readerProblem: Compare Promptwatch plans without treating separate prompt, response and agent-credit allowances as interchangeable.
topic.connection: Directly supports an AEOeye buyer scoping a recurring AI-search visibility and AEO-content workflow.

assessment: The final guide keeps prompts, responses, agent credits, projects and articles as independent constraints. It refuses to invent an annual discount from a toggle, clearly records automatic renewal and refund caution, and labels the unit figures as planning ratios rather than pay-as-you-go rates.

sources.supports: Official monthly plan prices, allowances, trial and annual-toggle context.
Official automatic-renewal, cancellation and non-refundable current-period payment terms.

checks: Opened every named official source and compared the visible price, currency, billing basis and allowances with the final article.
Recomputed the worked example from the published inputs and checked that caveats remain adjacent to the arithmetic.
Read the final opening, plan table, limitations, internal links and all four FAQs for consistency and documentation-only disclosure.
Confirmed the article makes no paid-account, accuracy, output-quality or hands-on performance claim.

pricing.billing: Monthly prices are verified; an annual toggle exists but no numeric annual discount was used.
pricing.verification: Checked the official pricing and terms pages, including four tracked models on each published tier. Recomputed Professional as US$245 / 150 = US$1.6333 per configured prompt-month and US$245 / 18,000 = US$0.01361 per response.
